projection.rule: Use one projection method consistently. Final controlled sheet format must show the first-angle projection symbol.

sheet.final_rule: A3/A4 only through controlled sheet format; borders/zones/title-block area must be template-controlled.

scales.rule: Intermediate 3:1 or 4:1 scales are prohibited on the controlled K01 profile unless a documented exceptional functional reason exists.

representation.rule: Line types/weights, leaders and reference lines are controlled by the drawing template/document properties; final visual QA required.
representation.section_rule: For parts with significant internal geometry, use sections/cuts per ISO 128-3:2022 when they communicate form more clearly than hidden-line external views. K01 P007 family policy selects an axial full section as primary; this is a project presentation rule, not a claim that all cylindrical parts must always be sectioned.

lettering.rule: Use controlled CAD lettering/font sizes consistently; no oversized file names or debug text.

dimensions.rule: Dimensions show actual values independent of view scale; no duplicate/conflicting characteristic specification; fit/tolerance semantics come from controlled PMI/Cxx.

gps.rule: GD&T/datums are added only from controlled engineering decisions; no decorative or default GD&T.

title_block.rule: One title block only; no full native file name as drawing title/number.

digital_product_definition.rule: 3D/Cxx/PMI remain semantic authority; 2D drawing is derivative presentation; manual semantic re-entry of released PMI is prohibited.

release_gates: controlled sheet format/template including projection symbol and ISO 7200 title block
all release-critical OPEN characteristics closed or explicitly blocking release
